class Line:
    def __init__(self, m, b):
        self.m = m
        self.b = b

    def get(self, x):
        return self.m * x + self.b

class LiChaoNode:
    def __init__(self, l, r):
        self.l = l
        self.r = r
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.line = None

class LiChaoTree:
    def __init__(self, x_left, x_right):
        self.root = LiChaoNode(x_left, x_right)

    def insert(self, node, new_line):
        l = node.l
        r = node.r
        if node.line is None:
            node.line = new_line
            return
        # Compare at mid
        mid = (l + r) // 2
        current_val = node.line.get(mid)
        new_val = new_line.get(mid)
        if new_val < current_val:
            node.line, new_line = new_line, node.line
        # Decide which child to go to
        if new_line.get(l) < new_line.get(r):
            if l == r:
                return
            if new_line.get(l) < node.line.get(l):
                if not node.left:
                    node.left = LiChaoNode(l, mid)
                self.insert(node.left, new_line)
            else:
                if not node.right:
                    node.right = LiChaoNode(mid + 1, r)
                self.insert(node.right, new_line)
        else:
            if l == r:
                return
            if new_line.get(r) < node.line.get(r):
                if not node.right:
                    node.right = LiChaoNode(mid + 1, r)
                self.insert(node.right, new_line)
            else:
                if not node.left:
                    node.left = LiChaoNode(l, mid)
                self.insert(node.left, new_line)

        if not node:
            return float('inf')
        res = node.line.get(x)
        mid = (node.l + node.r) // 2
        if x <= mid:
            left_res = self.query(node.left, x)
            return min(res, left_res)
        else:
            right_res = self.query(node.right, x)
            return min(res, right_res)
